candidates.claim: The MGMT_IN access list permits all IP traffic from MGMT 10.10.99.0/24 to CORP 192.168.30.0/24 (fw-01:81), an effective permit because the earlier entry fw-01:80 matches only UDP 123 to 10.10.20.5, and the ACL is applied inbound on the mgmt interface (fw-01:104); this is not one of the approved cross-zone services A1-A7.
candidates.remediation: Remove the permit at fw-01:81 or restrict it to the approved service A2 (MGMT to NTP 10.10.20.5 udp/123), and deny all other MGMT to CORP traffic.

candidates.claim: The baseline delta reports access-list MGMT_IN as added at fw-01:81, a line that does not exist in the approved baseline and must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added MGMT_IN line at fw-01:81 with the approved baseline, then either approve it with a documented exception or remove it.
